design_notes: The booking is two days before the flight. Early booking is expected 'where possible' (lines 110-113), and the 5 days of lines 270-271 are the form's turnaround, already done (signed 4 July). The taxi is a ground-transport matter. The lowest logical fare: JAL at 799.00 (line 119).
